items.headline: Gaza: khane wali gaadi par hamla, teen mare
items.detail: Gaza City ke Tel al-Hawa me khana pahuncha rahi gaadi par Israeli hamle me teen log mare gaye; Israel ne kaha woh Islamic Jihad ke ladake the, Hamas ne madhyasthon ki turant baithak mangi.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram, Israel-Hamas — UPSC IR

items.headline: France me chhathe hafte bhi bada pradarshan
items.detail: Mehngai aur kharab sarkari sevayon ke khilaf France bhar me chhathe hafte pradarshan hue; grih mantralaya ke mutabik 82,500 log shamil hue, 144 giraftar, kai jagah aansu gas chali.

items.headline: Iran me bijli rationing, ravivaar se katoti
items.detail: Yuddh se urja dhacha kshatigrast hone par Iran ne ravivaar se rolling power cut ki ghoshna ki — ilaake ke hisab se har do din me ya roz do ghante tak bijli band rahegi.
items.exam_angle: Iran urja sankat, yuddh ka asar — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Mecca kshetra me alert, missile roka gaya
items.detail: Shanivaar raat Houthi missile paschimi Saudi ki taraf aaya to Mecca prant me khatre ka alert jaari hua, thodi der me hata liya gaya; gathbandhan ne missile roka, Houthi ne Mecca ko nishana banane se inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi sangharsh, Mecca suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Nigeria: janaze wali naav palti, 24 mare
items.detail: Bayelsa me Ayama se Ukubie ja rahi bheed-bhaad wali naav shukravar ko palat gayi; NEMA ke mutabik 24 shav mile, 24 log bachaye gaye, talash jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Nigeria, aapda prabandhan — UPSC Geography

items.headline: NATO: Poland ki har inch zameen ki raksha
items.detail: NATO pramukh Rutte ne Warsaw me kaha woh Poland ki har inch zameen ki raksha ki guarantee dete hain; NATO parishad somvar ko ullanghan par baithak karegi.
items.exam_angle: NATO, Poland, Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran: Hormuz khul sakta hai, shartein manzoor hon
items.detail: Videsh mantri Araghchi ne kaha America 'uchit shartein' mane to Hormuz kholna mushkil nahi; up-mantri ne Americi naakaabandi ko 'shatrutapoorn' bataya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, Iran-America, tel vyapar — UPSC IR

items.headline: China ne US telecom pratibandh ka virodh kiya
items.detail: China ke vanijya mantralaya ne FCC ke faisle ka virodh kiya — China Mobile, China Telecom aur China Unicom ko US phone number se roka gaya; jawabi kadam ki chetavni di.
items.exam_angle: US-China, telecom, rashtriya suraksha — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Baltic me Russian jahaz par drone hamla, aag
items.detail: Finland ki khadi me Kaliningrad ja raha Sparta II drone hamle ke baad jal utha; 16 sadasyiya dal ko nikala gaya, Finland ko Ukraine par shak hai.
items.exam_angle: Baltic, Finland, Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Zelensky: Crimean Bridge hamla 'fair response'
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha Crimean Bridge par hamla Russia ke 109 pul-hamlon ka 'fair response' tha — pul ka beech wala hissa samundar me gira, gaadiyon ke liye band; UK ke raksha mantri ne Kyiv me samarthan jataya.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, Crimean Bridge — UPSC IR

items.headline: Qatar ne Tehran me vaarta ki
items.detail: Iran ke up-mantri ne kaha Qatar ka pratinidhimandal pichhli shaam Tehran aaya aur do ghante vaarta ki; yuddh khatm karne ki baatchit abhi atki hui hai.
items.exam_angle: West Asia kootniti, Qatar madhyasthata — UPSC IR

items.headline: Houthi missile Riyadh par, Saudi ne roke
items.detail: Saudi gathbandhan ne Riyadh ki taraf aaye teen Houthi ballistic missile roke; Houthi ne Hodeidah hamle ka badla lene ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: Yemen-Saudi sangharsh, Red Sea suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Myanmar ne ICJ faisla thukraya, France UNSC jayega
items.detail: France ne kaha woh UN Security Council ki baithak mangega, kyunki Myanmar ne Rohingya narasanhar par ICJ ke faisle ko manne se inkar kar diya.
items.exam_angle: ICJ faisla, Rohingya sankat — antarrashtriya kanoon

items.headline: Basra power station me aag, chaar ki maut
items.detail: Hartha power station me gas pipeline me aag lagi, kam se kam chaar mare aur tees ghayal; toll badhne ki aashanka hai.

items.headline: Iran ka Bahrain me US thikanon par hamla
items.detail: IRGC ne dava kiya usne Bahrain ki al-Riffa aur Awali bases par do US Patriot radar nishana banaye; Bahrain ne kaha uski vayu raksha ne hamle roke, ek audyogik jagah par aag lagi, koi ghayal nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America yuddh, Bahrain, US Fifth Fleet — UPSC IR

items.headline: Poland me Russian missile gira, NATO naraz
items.detail: Ukraine par raat ke hamle ke dauran do Russian missile aur ek drone Poland me gire; PM Tusk ne ise jaanboojh kar uksava bataya, NATO pramukh Rutte ne ise gambhir ullanghan kaha, koi ghayal nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Poland, NATO, Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Mexico ne FBI-wanted 'El Chapo Isidro' pakda
items.detail: Sinaloa ke Guasave me sena ne FBI ki 10 most-wanted list wale Fausto Isidro Meza Flores ko giraftar kiya; giraftari ke baad hui hinsa me 11 log mare gaye — saat sandigdh bandukdhari aur chaar sainik.
items.exam_angle: Mexico, drug cartel, FBI most-wanted — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran-America vaarta uranium par atki
items.detail: Madhyasthon ne kaha samvardhit uranium bhandar par matbhed se vaarta atki hai aur sangharsh phir bhadak sakta hai; Araghchi ne kaha Iran uranium desh se bahar nahi bhejega.
items.exam_angle: Iran parmanu vaarta, uranium, Hormuz — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran ka F-16 dava, America ne kharij kiya
items.detail: Iran ki sena ne dava kiya uski vayu raksha ne Khadi ke upar Americi F-16 par missile daagi aur use emergency landing karni padi; CENTCOM ne dava ko jhootha bataya, kaha koi F-16 par hamla hua hi nahi.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America tanav, Khadi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me tanker mine se takraya, aag lagi
items.detail: Iran ki nausena ke anusar Hormuz ke poorv me ek tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag ki lapeton me aa gaya; UKMTO ne Oman ke paas do tankeron par hamle ki bhi khabar di.
items.exam_angle: Strait of Hormuz, tel vyapar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kryvyi Rih par triple-tap hamla, bachcha mara
items.detail: Russia ke hamle me Kryvyi Rih me saat saal ka bachcha aur ek paramedic mare gaye, lagbhag 60 log ghayal hue; Zelensky ne ise aam nagrik ilake par hamla bataya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: UN: killer robot par niyam 2028 tak
items.detail: Geneva me 128 deshon ne sahmati di ki ghatak swayatt hathiyaron par sambhavit niyam 2028 tak taiyar kiye jayenge; badhyakari niyamon par sahmati nahi bani.
items.exam_angle: UN CCW, swayatt hathiyar — UPSC IR/S&T

items.headline: EU ka Big Tech par 3% tax prastav
items.detail: European Council ke pramukh Antonio Costa ne 2028-2034 ke budget ke liye badi digital companies par 3% levy ka prastav diya; 204 arab euro ki katauti bhi prastavit hai, samjhauta December tak chahiye.
items.exam_angle: EU budget, digital tax, Big Tech — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Videsh data centre par Trump ki tax-dhamki
items.detail: Rashtrapati Trump ne kaha videsh me data centre banane wali Americi companies par 'tremendous tax' lagega; AI me China se aage rehne ke liye desh ke andar nivesh chahiye.
items.exam_angle: America, AI, data centre, China — UPSC IR/Economy
